item.title: Meta's multi-billion settlement launches the next phase of national tech regulation
item.description: Meta's settlement with states in a child safety case this week had a big payout, but the attorneys general have their eyes on a bigger prize: national regulation of social media companies.
item.content:encoded: Meta's settlement with states in a child safety case this week had a big payout, but the attorneys general have their eyes on a bigger prize: national regulation of social media companies.

item.title: Lights out, Instagram off? The changes to Meta for teens could be a big deal
item.description: Researchers and advocates are applauding the changes that Meta agreed to make for minors on Instagram and Facebook. Cutting kids off at night and during the school day are two big changes.

item.description: Obsessing over your looks should not take up all your energy, says psychologist Diana Hill. If you're struggling with uncomfortable thoughts about your body, ground yourself with these techniques.

item.title: What a fake poll reveals about worries around prediction markets and the midterms
item.description: While a stunt involving fake polls may not have been an effort to rig prediction markets, concerns are growing ahead of the midterms about other attempts to influence the betting sites.

item.title: Judge says Pentagon's measures against Anthropic were 'illegal and baseless'
item.description: A judge issued a written order Thursday night that the Pentagon acted illegally by punishing the AI company for its criticism of the Department of Defense's views on AI use. The government is expected to fight the ruling.
